title: Brogue
summary: BROGUE, noun brog. 1. A shoe. 'Clouted brogues.' in Shakespeare, signify shoes whose soles are studded with nails, or clouts. 2. A cant word for a corrupt dialect or manner of pronunciation. 3. Brogue

inlines.v: BROGUE, noun brog. 1. A shoe. 'Clouted brogues.' in Shakespeare, signify shoes whose soles are studded with nails, or clouts. 2. A cant word for a corrupt dialect or manner of pronunciation. 3. Brogues is used by Shenstone for breeches, from the Irish brog.
